_comment: The sibling tools setup installs FROM: dependencies, never targets (PLAN-repo-setup.md §7.12). Each `path` is relative to the workspace top, found by walking up from this tool until <top>/<path> is a git work tree (setuplib/deps.py). The one data file exempt from the content audit, which would otherwise forbid naming them; the direction audit still reads it. `setup audit deps` (in ./dev.sh audit): each one resolves to a discovered repo with its `cli` executable, its `source` a folder and its `runner` a file, else FAIL; nothing discovered is UNCHECKED. Keys starting with _ are comments; every other key is read by setuplib/deps.py (tests/test_deps.py holds both directions).

hooks._used_by: the hooks component: the default hook source (<path>/<source>), the listing (`<cli> list --json --source <source>`: name, path, dest, test), and the one comparator by meaning (<comparator.module>.<comparator.function>, imported from <path>). --hooks-from DIR overrides the source; without this dependency it is the only source, compared byte for byte

checks._used_by: the parts component: the shared suite runner (<path>/<runner>), rendered byte for byte into each repo (components.json `parts`); and `setup plans`: the practice registry (<path>/<registry>, its `rules[].id`, read only), where each id a `## Practices` section names, and each gate row an approved decision names, must resolve (setuplib/practices.py, PLAN-services §3 A1, A3). --checks CLI still has no default (a run of the shared checks costs minutes)

docs._used_by: the docs component: the shared docs index that reads each repo's docs declaration. Its file name (<reader.module>.<reader.declaration>), its grammar (<reader.parse>(text, label), raising on a line it does not read) and its resolution (<reader.resolve>(repo name, repo dir, rows) -> (docs, failed)) are imported from <path>, never copied here. Without this dependency nothing reads a declaration, so none is written

research._used_by: `setup plans`: the `## Research` id rules (setuplib/rsids.py, PLAN-services §3 R1, R6). Each `rs-` id a plan not done cites is resolved with `<cli> get <id> --json` (a read; the caller's environment passed through), and one cited under `## Decisions` must be answered at full depth. Without this dependency, ids cited are UNCHECKED, exit 3, never ok
